# BNL Community Fixes v2.4.4

Replay lag fixes and single-instance launcher.

## Changes
- Fixed severe replay lag caused by thousands of per-frame exceptions during replay playback.
- Patched `TeamFieldOfView.IsInVisionSector` and `IsVisibleTroughBlocks` to guard against destroyed Unity objects instead of crashing.
- Patched `UnitGhostHandler.Update` to guard nullable `buildStartTime`/`buildEndTime` fields before accessing `.Value`.
- Patched `GuiFollow.Update` to return early when `Camera.main` is null during replay.
- Opening the launcher now automatically kills any other running launcher instances.
- F8 in-game menu: map render preset and hide impact VFX settings now sync back to the launcher UI.
- F8 in-game menu: removed debug force start match option.
- WSI scale settings are now saved and loaded correctly in the launcher.
